title: Sensei Governed Runner Composition Runner Receipt V1
description: O3's own closed evidence document: a second, later layer of truth than O2's Receipt, never a rewrite of it. Records exactly how far one generation attempt's runner sequence (snapshot -> workspace/buffer init -> provider construction -> O2 Run -> workspace freezing -> evidence computation -> verification -> sealing) progressed via a closed, ten-value disposition, referencing O2's Request/Result/Receipt digests without altering them.
$comment: Canonical producer/owner: globulario/sensei, golang/architecture/runnercomposition. Per docs/design/governed-runner-composition-o3.md hard laws 5a, 6a, 8a, 13, 14a: only a Result whose RunnerReceipt.disposition is verified reaches MapToCommand. Digest fields other than request_digest_sha256 are nullable exactly per the disposition/evidence-presence matrix in the design doc -- see the allOf conditionals below, which are that matrix encoded as schema. cleanup_succeeded/cleanup_failure_detail are ORTHOGONAL to disposition, not folded into it -- and cleanup_succeeded is NOT a strict function of disposition alone for workspace-init-failure, where either null or a boolean is valid.

request_digest_sha256.$comment: References the providerport.Request this attempt was constructed for. Always present -- the request exists before the runner sequence begins.

failure_detail.$comment: Required non-empty exactly when disposition is not verified; empty when verified.

cleanup_succeeded.$comment: Orthogonal to disposition, and not a strict function of it: null for snapshot-failure (no ephemeral surface can exist yet), a boolean for every disposition from provider-construction-failure onward, and EITHER for workspace-init-failure (whether a partial ephemeral surface existed before that failure is not generally knowable).

cleanup_failure_detail.$comment: Required non-empty exactly when cleanup_succeeded is false; empty when cleanup_succeeded is null or true.

completed_at.$comment: Observation timestamp, explicitly excluded from runner_receipt_digest_sha256 so receipt identity does not depend on wall-clock time.

runner_receipt_digest_sha256.$comment: Self-referential semantic digest of this document with this field zeroed before hashing.

allOf.$comment: Group A: snapshot-failure -- O2's Run was never invoked, no snapshot exists, no ephemeral surface can exist.

Group B digest shape: workspace-init-failure, provider-construction-failure, o2-run-error -- snapshot succeeded (input digest known), O2's Run never produced a valid Result. cleanup_succeeded is intentionally NOT constrained here -- it differs per member, see the two groups below.
Group B cleanup, definite: provider-construction-failure, o2-run-error -- the ephemeral surface (from workspace init, which by definition succeeded to reach these dispositions) definitely exists.

Group C: o2-non-completed, workspace-freeze-failure, evidence-computation-failure -- O2's Run produced a valid Result/Receipt, but either TerminalOutcome was not completed, freezing the workspace afterward failed, or computing evidence itself failed. All three definitely have an ephemeral surface.
Group D: seal-failure -- verification completed and matched, but CandidateArtifactStore.Put failed.
Group E: digest-mismatch, verified -- every stage through sealing completed.
